title: Cheesy Fried Flautas

notes: Partial — video only. The Facebook reel (by creator 'Drew Eats') did not include a written recipe in the caption. Checked 16 of 936 comments (sorted by Most Relevant and All Comments) and found no pinned recipe comment from the creator — only reactions and side suggestions from other viewers (e.g. one suggested adding black beans, salsa, taco rice, and peppers before rolling; another suggested pouring green enchilada sauce over before cooking). Commenters identified the dish as 'flautas' (flour-tortilla version of taquitos, which use corn tortillas). Exact cheese type, dipping sauce recipe, and cook temperature/time were not stated anywhere in the accessible text.
